aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Stratford, run by Hamish and Kate Scott. We're your local STIHL dealer, here to stock what you need for outdoor power equipment work around your property and garden. We know Stratford and understand what our locals rely on to get the job done.

We sell STIHL equipment and keep parts in stock for customers. When your STIHL needs repairs or servicing, bring it in and we'll get it running again. We're here to answer questions and give you advice on what you actually need.

Whether you're after new equipment, replacement parts for something you already own, or need your STIHL serviced, come and see us. We're open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. Pop in whenever you need us.
